residual_risks: An offline-paid journal row stays release_pending/held on the device (it never becomes a permit-backed completion); the sweep treats it as settled work, not unfinished recovery.
Chunk size is measured on the JSON wire length (1_000_000 chars) under the Edge 2 MB body cap; a single receipt larger than the cap is still sent alone.

readOfflineReceiptForResult() pre-filters candidate rows with an owner-scoped `receipt LIKE %"<resultId>"%` JSON substring match and then confirms parseReceiptRow(row).resultId === resultId; a normalized result_id column would replace the substring pre-filter in a later schema change.

A receipt whose grant row is unreadable stays queued indefinitely on the device (reported as `unreadable`); it is settled only if the grant bytes become readable again or the owner purges the account. It is never presented under bytes the device cannot vouch for.

An original paid offline is settled by analysis_offline_completion, not by the permit-backed completion columns; readers must join the side table (readOperationRows does) — a reader that consults analysis_logical_operations alone sees an unfinished operation.
implement.summary: Court-offline scored read on the shipping path (AnalyzeScreen -> prepareOriginalCaptureAnalysis -> runOriginalCaptureAnalysis) and on plain runCaptureAnalysis: connectivity-class permit failure + cached release policy + executable held grant -> on-device rating, exactly one consumeOfflineAllocation() in the commit transaction, saveOfflineAnalysis() writes local_shot (digest-bound to the receipt) with NO shot.sync outbox row, the receipt drain sends the frozen 1.0 wire entry { receipt, grant:{schemaVersion,compactJws}, output } in bounded chunks, hasShotSyncReceipt() is written only on an accepted settlement, a lost commit acknowledgement returns the durable paid read, the SHIPPING sync runtime's recovery sweep never reserves a live permit for an operation already paid offline, an owner purge removes every offline wallet row of that owner, and the Result surface names queued / presented-unanswered / HELD / REFUSED / ACCEPTED receipts truthfully. r8 (coordinator follow-up on the ACCEPTED r7, new commit 48d3db71 on top of 389bfbf7, nothing amended) closes the verify-7 adversary's four residual breaks: (P2) the offline commit re-reads trusted time at the moment of spending and consumeOfflineAllocation() judges the lease with THAT reading — a lease that expires during inference returns the honest `unavailable` outcome, consumes zero allocations, writes no receipt and no scored local_shot; an unreadable clock at spend time is offline.time_reconcile_required, mapped to the same `unavailable`; (P2) a pending receipt whose offline_grant row is missing or fails its stored digest is skipped by the drain — never presented, never dropped, reported in `unreadable` — so the owner's other receipts under intact grants still settle instead of the whole drain aborting; (P3) freeLimitReached is computed from every ACTIVE held identity_lifetime_free grant on the device after the spend (true only when no free ticket remains spendable), not from the paying grant alone; (P3) authority selection prefers a held verified_store lease over spending an identity_lifetime_free ticket (Pro court-offline read: ticket null, free tickets untouched). r9 (coordinator follow-up on 48d3db71, new commit 02b16c42, nothing amended) closes the verify-8 adversary's single P1 (D1): a cancellation that lands the instant the court-offline COMMIT is durable is no longer answered with the 'cancelled' copy — the catch path now reads the durable paid rating (receipt + spent ticket + scored local_shot, digest-bound) regardless of the cancel flag and returns {kind:'scored'} with the committed freeLimitReached, exactly the durable outcome the live path preserves for the same race; a rolled-back (not durable) cancel still returns 'cancelled' with nothing spent. r10 (coordinator follow-up on 02b16c42, new commit 9110778e, nothing amended) closes the verify-9 adversary's six P1 + one P2: a court-offline AUTO DETECT abstention (plain path) is loadable/confirmable ('release_pending', never 'blocked'/'corrupt'), the offline confirmation with a held grant scores and its replay returns the durable paid rating; app restart + signal (shipping sync-runtime sweep) leaves it confirmable; the SHIPPING original path (prepareOriginalCaptureAnalysis -> runOriginalCaptureAnalysis) paid offline is finalized as a durable settlement the Library opens (load_result) and a second run replays (scored, replayed:true) with exactly one ticket consumed and one receipt queued; 'Check saved analysis' (reconcileOriginalCaptureAnalysis) and the recovery sweep never reserve a live permit for an operation already paid offline; a court-offline original low_confidence abstention finalizes and replays deterministically.
